charizard.evidence: Tip is the mean world position of left/right upper_jaw_a and left/right lower_jaw, converted to head-local space at source t=2.375. Forward follows head to center_nose. The static socket approximates the mouth center during the open-jaw window; jaw has secondary motion. Jaw opening peaks at2.375 and stays >=80% of its maximum from1.7917 to2.9583. These effects/timing are authored recommendations for the supplied generic attack clip, not official Flamethrower animation event metadata.
charizard.timeUnits: seek, powerAt, sustainEnd, end, recoverAt and pulseTimes are source clip seconds; speed is playback rate; projectileLifetime is wall seconds
charizard.coordinateUnits: tip and forward are absolute points in the named bone local space, not direction vectors

blastoise.evidence: Each terminal barrel has177 fully weighted vertices attached to its b_02 bone. Native bone-local geometry spans X=-.00763.. .26094; Y/Z roughly +/-.083. Both barrels therefore emit along local +X, not global +Z. Cannon-forward maxima occur source t=1.67..1.72 after the windup. Body holds the extended firing pose through roughly3.0; chosen envelope is a recommendation.

greninja.evidence: Throwing hand is left_hand_24, not jaw_01_5/head_8. Tip is the mean of left middle/index/ring first finger joints transformed into hand-local space. Forward is measured hand velocity from source .65 to .666667, transformed into the hand frame at .683333. Peak forward hand velocity occurs .658333; hand extends and holds from about .70 to1.0. Capture world origin and direction once at release; never keep released shuriken attached to the wrist. Source clip is named rangeattack01, not an explicit named Water Shuriken event track.
